name: ColorArea
summary: Change two channels of a colour at once, by default saturation across and brightness up, on a square of colour with one thumb. Each channel is a hidden slider read with the system's words (Saturation 76%, Brightness 85%, Blue; التشبع 76%، السطوع 85%، أزرق) and digits stay Western. The drag has paths without it: the arrow keys, Page keys, Home and End, and a press anywhere on the area. On web a rounded square with a ringed thumb; on ios the spectrum view of the colour panel, the square over the hue slider; on android the same form, as Material has no colour area.
useWhen: Setting saturation and brightness together for a hue
The spectrum view of a colour picker (ColorPicker)
avoidWhen: Picking from a few named colours

value.description: The colour, controlled: hex, rgb(), hsl() or hsb(), or a React Aria Color. Pass the Color from onChange back to keep the hue of a grey.

onChange.description: Called as the colour changes, with the colour as a string in the area's colour space and as a Color.

onChangeEnd.description: Called when a drag or a key press ends.

colorSpace.description: The colour space of the two channels.

xChannel.description: The channel across. In right to left it runs from the right.

xName.description: The name of the hidden input of the channel across, in a form.

yName.description: The name of the hidden input of the channel up, in a form.

locale.description: The locale of the words and the direction. Default the language of the nearest Theme. Digits stay Western through -u-nu-latn.

a11y.role: group named Saturation and brightness (التشبع والسطوع) or the aria-label given, holding two visually hidden inputs type range from React Aria, one per channel, each named by its channel and read as a 2D slider (منزلق ثنائي الاتجاه).
a11y.focus: One Tab stop: the input of the channel moved last, the channel across at first. The focus ring (focus.shadow.ring) draws around the thumb; it is hidden only under data-modality pointer.

keys.ArrowRight: One step up the channel across; one step down in right to left, where it runs from the right. Shift for a large step.
keys.ArrowLeft: One step down the channel across; one step up in right to left. Shift for a large step.
keys.ArrowUp: One step up the channel up. Shift for a large step.
keys.ArrowDown: One step down the channel up. Shift for a large step.
keys.PageUp: A large step up the channel up
keys.PageDown: A large step down the channel up
keys.Home: A large step toward the start of the channel across (the left, the right in right to left)
keys.End: A large step toward the end of the channel across
keys.Pointer: Drag the thumb, or press anywhere on the area to move the thumb there; a touch drag never scrolls the page. The keys and a single press are the paths that need no drag (WCAG 2.2 2.5.7).

a11y.announce: Saturation, 2D slider, Saturation 76%, Brightness 85%, Blue. Arabic: التشبع، منزلق ثنائي الاتجاه، التشبع 76%، السطوع 85%، أزرق.
notes: React Aria names both inputs Color picker, reads the role 2D slider with a diacritic and Latin 2D in Arabic, and joins its own channel and colour names with a Latin comma in English order; after each render the name, the role and the value text of each input are replaced with the system's (colorAreaValueText).
Digits stay Western: React Aria runs with an -u-nu-latn locale.
WCAG 2.2 1.4.11: the area and the thumb have an edge in color.border.control, 3:1 or more; the thumb has a ring of the surface colour so it shows on any part of the gradient.
WCAG 2.2 2.5.8: the thumb is at least 24 by 24 (size.control.sm, larger on touch platforms).
Under forced colors the gradient keeps its colours (forced-color-adjust none), edges are CanvasText and focus is a Highlight outline.

en.aria-label: What the colour is for, as a noun, when the default name is not enough: Fill colour. Sentence case.

ar.aria-label: اسم الغرض من اللون بدون تشكيل: لون التعبئة.

react.behavior: React Aria ColorArea and ColorThumb (react-aria-components) through their render props; words and value text from areaText.ts (to move to packages/shared/src/color.ts)
react.note: Motion: while dragged the thumb's surface ring grows by border.width.strong (a box shadow; React Aria owns the thumb's transform) and settles on release, on duration.base. Reduced motion: the ring changes at once, as every duration token is 0ms.

angular.note: New wave 2: div[dsColorArea] with the same DOM, two hidden range inputs and the same gradient math.

native.note: Phase R5 draws it: a gradient square and a thumb on Reanimated, exposed as two adjustable elements with the increment and decrement actions.

styles.web: A rounded square of the gradient, filling its container, 220px tall at the default density, a round thumb with a surface ring.
styles.ios: The spectrum view of the colour panel: the square fills the sheet's width over the hue slider, the corner of the panel's content, the thumb as on the sliders. Content, so solid.
styles.android: The same form at the Android control sizes; the thumb grows to the Android target.
styles.studio: The same on the Studio tokens; no recipe.
styles.desk: The same on the Desk tokens; no recipe.
styles.neutral: The same on the Neutral tokens; no recipe.
styles.liquid: The same on the Liquid tokens; the thumb may take glass in a later look order, the area stays solid.

mistakes.wrong: A colour area alone, with no other way to set the colour
mistakes.right: Put it in a ColorPicker, or put a ColorField beside it for typing

mistakes.wrong: Passing the hex string back on every change
mistakes.right: Pass the Color from onChange back, so the hue of a grey is kept
